name: Facing Negolash
summary: Along Stranglethorn Vale's coast, a stolen cutlass sets events in motion. Sprogger knows how to draw Negolash out with the giant's favorite food and drink.

sections.title: A Hungry Giant
sections.body: When giants wrecked Captain Smotts' vessel, Negolash headed for the galley. He left the crew alone and went after wine and Barbecued Buzzard Wings, Sprogger's specialty. Sprogger had traveled to the Badlands to learn the recipe.

sections.title: The Trap in the Lifeboat
sections.body: Sprogger plans to lure Negolash with a feast. You carry ten servings of wings and five bottles of wine to Captain Smotts' ruined lifeboat on the southeastern shore. The banquet draws the giant near. Then you can confront him and reclaim the captain's cutlass.

faq.answer: Negolash is a giant who helped wreck Captain Smotts' ship. He ransacked the galley for food and drink instead of hunting the sailors.

faq.q: Why does Sprogger know how to lure Negolash?
faq.answer: Sprogger saw Negolash raid his kitchen during the shipwreck. The giant favored Sprogger's Barbecued Buzzard Wings and bottles of Junglevine Wine, so those provisions make suitable bait.

faq.q: Where does the confrontation take place?
faq.answer: The confrontation takes place in Captain Smotts' ruined lifeboat, stranded on the coast southeast of Sprogger.
The trail begins with The Monogrammed Sash and continues through The Captain's Cutlass before this confrontation.

angles.text: As a cook, you can appreciate Sprogger's craft. He traveled to the Badlands to learn the specialized recipe for Barbecued Buzzard Wings at the heart of his plan.
